page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.c1 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and operates under the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 8 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing a total of 8 vCPUs with no hyperthreading overhead.

The hardware configuration includes 16.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per CPU core. This instance does not include any bundled local storage or integrated graphics processing units, meaning all storage requirements must be handled via network-attached block storage.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio make this instance suitable for compute-bound tasks that do not require large memory capacities. It is designed for workloads such as batch processing, web serving, and dedicated application hosting.
